title: Microbial community analysis during granulation in replicate reactors
description: Aiming to unravel the ecological mechanisms behind the granulation process, the microbial community during granulation in replicate reactors was analysed. The results of this study help us to understand the ecological factors involved in the microbial community assemblage during the granulation of activated sludge into granules and the reproducibility of the process.
